description: This is a React component source file written in TypeScript. It primarily manages MCP servers, including fetching, displaying, filtering, deleting, and creating servers within a user interface.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles marking a server for deletion and opening the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms and performs the deletion of the selected MCP server via API call.

methods.name: cancelDelete
methods.description: Cancels the deletion process and closes the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleCreateSuccess
methods.description: Updates the server list upon successful creation of a new MCP server.
